features: Each champion has a real cooldown-based active combat power triggered by keyboard Q or an iPhone POWER rune: Void Warden Astral Nova, Frost Sentinel Glacial Bulwark, and Ember Reaver Infernal Cleave.

Astral Nova damages and knocks back nearby enemies; Bulwark freezes surrounding enemies and grants temporary invulnerability; Infernal Cleave delivers directional area damage and burning damage-over-time.
Three permanent-within-run upgrade evolutions at Rank 3: Sovereign Blades sweeping attacks, Celestial Storm splitting projectiles, and Immortal Aegis blocking periodic incoming hits.
New skill-ready/cooldown HUD, accessible touch skill control, timed hero defenses, frozen/burning enemy status graphics, and evolved attack/impact effects.
Boss spawning gains a timed entrance effect; the Warden's Codex shows evolution progress and the guide explains abilities.
Retains v1.3 Armory, champions, forgeable relics, Renown, all scores, mobile controls, Nightfall enemies, offline PWA and independent personal-media storage.
privacy: Scores only in this game's localStorage; no access to Asset Alchemist video files.
